label: RFC-0042 slice 2: DataFusion 55 vs DuckDB on net_balances, re-running RFC-0013 §4
query: net_balances - the i128 signed fold over a string-typed uint256 value column
note: Every size run in both engine orders; the fixture is written with Arrow 58, what nuthatch actually seals. Parity is the acceptance criterion and passed at every size before any timing was recorded.
conclusion: RFC-0013's core finding survives: the gap widens with size and DataFusion remains ~2.6x slower at 20M. What changed is the small end - at 2M DataFusion is now faster (0.84x, was 1.85x). Both engines got ~2.2-2.3x faster in absolute terms since 2026-08-02, so neither pulled ahead. The dominant untested variable is segment layout: this fixture is one segment, a real nest has 10,923 with a 6.3 KB median (#889).
